bird_1037.sql: SELECT (SUM(pa.preferred_foot = 'left') * 100.0) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

SELECT SUM(pa.preferred_foot = 'left') * 100.0 / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';

SELECT (SUM(pa.preferred_foot = 'left') * 100.0) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992;

SELECT (SUM(PA.preferred_foot = 'left') * 100.0) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage FROM Player_Attributes AS PA INNER JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_fifa_api_id = P.player_fifa_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', P.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(pa.preferred_foot = 'left') / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(pa.preferred_foot = 'left') / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(left_flag) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_left_foot FROM (SELECT p.player_fifa_api_id, MAX(CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS left_flag FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE CAST(substr(p.birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992 GROUP BY p.player_fifa_api_id) AS t;
